blocks.text: In 1901, Max Planck suggested that energy is radiated or absorbed in discrete packets of energy called quanta rather than as a continuous wave. Quanta is plural of quantum, a discrete packet of energy. Each quantum is associated with radiations of a single frequency. The energy E of each quantum is proportional to its frequency f related as

blocks.title: For your information
blocks.text: The one important constant h is a constant of quantum theory and another important constant c is the speed of light c which is a constant of special theory of relativity.
where h is Planck's constant, its value is 6.63 × 10⁻³⁴ J s.
Max Planck received Nobel Prize in physics in 1918 for his discovery of energy quanta.
